0022600160.text: The Atlanta Hawks (3-4, 1-2 on the road... wait, 2-2 on the road) sit 2nd in the Southeast, 0.5 games back, and 7th in the East after losing their last game, while the Indiana Pacers (2-5) are 3rd in the Central, 3.5 games back, and 12th in the East, having dropped four straight. In the 2025-26 season series, the Hawks won 2-1, and the teams have no games yet in 2026-27; the most recent meeting was a 129-124 Indiana win in Indianapolis on January 31. Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (knee), Jock Landale (hip), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), all out, plus Kingston Flemings (suspension), while Jalen Johnson is day-to-day with an ankle injury; Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), and Obi Toppin is day-to-day with back soreness.
